environment.description: Container running as feedback-processor service on ECS Fargate. Container image based on python:3.11-slim. FEEDBACK_STORAGE=/var/lib/feedback (bind-mounted EFS volume, rw). FEEDBACK_OUTPUT=/var/www/reports (bind-mounted to nginx sidecar serving on port 8080, accessible via internal ALB). Container runs as non-root user (uid 1000). No CSP headers configured on nginx sidecar. Reports served with Content-Type: text/html.

config.network: internal ALB serving reports on port 8080
